goal: Visitors can evaluate, install, and inspect Skills while the Rust service records privacy-bounded visit and engagement aggregates.
test_paths: cargo fmt --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --check && cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cd web && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && cd .. && python3 skills/amicro-universal-frontend-style/scripts/verify_amicro_style.py web --strict --format json && openspec validate skill-product-foundation --strict
non_goals: Do not expand scope beyond the active change.
Do not bypass component extraction rules.
expected_evidence: Rust fmt, test, and Clippy command output
Frontend typecheck, lint, format, build, and Amicro strict output
unsafe_assumptions: Forwarding headers are trustworthy without a configured proxy CIDR.
Missing npm data is equivalent to zero downloads.
Raw IP rows can be retained indefinitely or exposed through metrics.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation needs files outside scope, a new tracking field, a breaking public contract, or deployment/publishing.
